name: haoqi-3d
description: 好奇果冻 3D 公众号版：暖象牙底、果冻蓝标题、黏土多巴胺配图与安全的 inline HTML 组件。Three.js 只用于制作/截取素材，不在微信正文中运行。
container_style: max-width:677px; margin:0 auto; padding:20px 14px; background:#F5F1E8; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Helvetica Neue','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;

tags.h1: display:block; color:#151A22; font-size:22px; font-weight:900; line-height:1.35; letter-spacing:1px; margin:34px 0 18px; padding-left:14px; border-left:7px solid #6D8FF2;
tags.h2: display:block; color:#151A22; font-size:18px; font-weight:900; line-height:1.5; margin:34px 0 16px; padding:10px 14px; background:#DCE8F2; border-left:5px solid #F08A5D;
tags.h3: display:block; color:#31416F; font-size:16px; font-weight:800; line-height:1.5; margin:26px 0 12px; padding-bottom:7px; border-bottom:2px solid #AABCF2;
tags.p: font-size:15px; line-height:1.95; color:#3F4652; margin:16px 0; letter-spacing:0.2px; text-align:justify; word-break:break-word;
tags.blockquote: background-image:url({{asset:panel-blue}}); background-size:100% 100%; border:none; padding:24px 22px; margin:26px 4px; color:#FFDAA9; font-size:15px; line-height:1.85;
tags.code: background:#E5EBF5; color:#425FC9; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:13px; font-family:Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
tags.pre: background:#151A22; color:#DCE8F2; padding:16px; overflow-x:auto; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7;
